history.content: Am I ready for my interview tomorrow?

I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. It's 11:11 AM now, so you've got just under 3 hours. What the calendar shows around it: Today 2:00 PM, BigCo interview Today 6:30 PM, Gym Tomorrow 9:00 AM, Dentist (that's the only thing on Tuesday) I checked your calendar only, I haven't read your mail for any prep materials or last minute instructions from BigCo, and there are no reminders set for the interview. Want me to scan your email for anything from them, or set a reminder to leave buffer before 2? What I have not checked: your inbox, commitments — so treat the above as partial until that is read.
